reason: Adaptive/fixed policies query different inputs; comparing separate arm-specific withheld 32-bit sets would confound policy performance with evaluation set difficulty. Freeze a common matched question set before implementing source or observing consequences.
questions: The same 16 x values per world never appear in either policy arm's observed interventions, enabling paired input/world comparisons, while each arm still gets 32 distinct paid actions.

construction.remaining32: all x=0..63 absent from baseline fixed32
construction.common_held16: first16 x sorted by (SHA256('WSP137|COMMONHELD|'+str(x)), x) among remaining32
construction.legal_training_pool48: all other 48 x. Both numeric arms have identical 48 eligible actions. Fixed policy still uses exactly original 32 actions.
construction.active_first_four: first four original fixed32 x, then 28 source-blind adaptive picks from unqueried training_pool48
construction.common_held_public: The 16 excluded x are inferable from the public eligible-action pool. Task-query positions are known; do not claim task-blind unfamiliar query transfer.
construction.secondary_held: remaining 16 unobserved within pool per arm, score and report separately; arm-specific full32 withheld scores cannot be compared as a paired item-level test

primary_decision_denominators.paired_test_set: same per-world x and hidden truth, predictions frozen after all 32 observations, no feedback after score
primary_decision_denominators.strong_comparisons: same-information symbolic on exactly same actions for each policy, conventional fully trained CART, source-class-informed oracle as informational reference only

governance.immutable_study_protocol: Both original prereg and this append-only pre-source clarification govern WSP137. Later code/outcome may not change either.
